steps.title: aim, then land
steps.body:
Play a 2-bar phrase that *ends* on the 3rd of the next chord, landing on beat 1. The targets are the downbeats of bars 1 and 3. Pick the landing note first, then work backwards.

In G major, a phrase over bars 1 and 2 lands on bar 3's `Em7`: its 3rd is G.

steps.title: call and response
steps.body:
Now the jam shape: play bars 1 and 2 and land on bar 3's downbeat, rest for the rest of bar 3, then play a short turnaround in bar 4 into the top of the loop. A note during the rest breaks it.

In F minor, a phrase over bars 1 and 2 lands on bar 3's `Fm7`: its 3rd is A♭.
